description: PyPI-published agents installed with uv - the ecosystem the query used to miss entirely.
why: npm and brew are pinned to 0 on purpose: a uv or pipx install produces no npm global and no Homebrew row, so before this branch existed a machine full of Python agents was indistinguishable from a clean one. If npm or brew ever goes non-zero here the scenario has stopped testing the thing it was built for. The branch globs install LOCATIONS rather than querying python_packages, which costs 15.6s and does not honour WHERE push-down.
